title: Zoom Recognizer Options
description: Zoom Scribe (Live mode) STT options. Only applies when recognizer vendor is 'zoom'. Zoom segments turns server-side and returns one final transcript per speech turn: there are no interim results and no confidence scores (transcripts are reported with confidence 1.0). Supported languages: en-US, zh-CN, ja-JP, es-ES, it-IT, fr-FR, de-DE, ar-SA, ar-AE, pt-BR, pt-PT.

apiKey.description: Zoom Build platform API key (or JWT). Overrides the key configured in jambonz.

zoomSttUri.description: Custom host to connect to instead of api.zoom.us (e.g. a proxy).

zoomSttUseTls.description: Use TLS when connecting to a custom host. Default true.
